summary: NextNav Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the redemption of all outstanding public warrants at $0.01 per warrant, with a redemption date of June 26, 2026. Holders may exercise warrants for cash at $11.50 per common share before 5:00 p.m. on the redemption date. Private placement warrants are not subject to this redemption. This is a routine warrant redemption notice, not a special situation.
